sources.title: basecompute/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BaseRT.base builds of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B for fast local inference on Apple Silicon (Metal). A dense 27B vision-language reasoning model with hybrid attention (Gated DeltaNet + periodic full attention). Q4 needs ~24 GB Apple Silicon (tight); Q8 needs 48 GB+

sources.title: 15% More Accurate Than Unsloth: Qwen-3.8-27B Quants for Local Agents
sources.snippet: Today we're releasing Qwen3.8-27B-BaseQuant-V1: quantised builds of Qwen3.8-27B in three sizes, each the same size as the matching Unsloth dynamic quant and each closer to the full-precision model. On prompts from six public datasets (coding agents, function calling and chat), BaseQuant has 15% lower KL divergence than Unsloth at both 3 and 4 bits, including UD-Q4_K_M, the size most people run.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: The Qwen3.8 27B native vision-language dense model builds upon the 3.6-27B version, with key improvements in coding and office productivity capabilities across both text and visual modalities. It enables more reliable end-to-end completion of complex tasks, delivering consistently trustworthy results.
